interpretation.timing: Felt from October 24, 2026 to January 26, 2027, coming nearest on December 10, 2026.
interpretation.impact: The wish to have it all is asked to pick, which can focus your growth.
interpretation.guidance: Meet the demand with patience and a clear priority, which turns friction into practice. If you want more, you can start by deciding what would count as enough.

interpretation.summary: Your habitual shield and a newer kindness barely touch, as the South Node makes a semi-square to your natal Chiron.
interpretation.timing: In effect from October 25 to December 3, exact on November 11.
interpretation.impact: A touch of vulnerability appears in an ordinary exchange and is gone almost before you name it. The South Node is moving through your house of self, which may show in how you enter any gathering.
interpretation.guidance: Should an old twinge appear, you might acknowledge it, ask what set it off, or let it pass.

interpretation.summary: Your tender side catches a little on your chosen route while the North Node forms a sesquiquadrate to your natal Chiron.
interpretation.timing: In effect from October 25 to December 3, exact on November 11.
interpretation.impact: One tender habit of thought gets brushed, and you notice how you talk to yourself.
interpretation.guidance: A short gesture toward yourself, such as a kind sentence or a quiet minute, suits the mood.

interpretation.summary: Mercury forms a sextile to your natal Uranus. Online talk and curious company give you a new way to look at an old topic.
interpretation.timing: In effect from November 1 to November 26, exact on November 6 and November 21.
interpretation.impact: Freedom feels easy to claim, and your originality meets little resistance. Your house of romance and play is where your natal Uranus lives, so this may reach a crush or a hobby.
interpretation.guidance: Make the call, send the message or hold the conversation that matters, since words go smoothly. A conversation with someone unlike you could widen your outlook.

interpretation.summary: Glamour and mystery color your wants, so asking what is real keeps you honest now that Lilith is conjunct your natal Neptune.
interpretation.timing: Exact on January 22, 2027, and felt from November 12, 2026 to April 4, 2027.
interpretation.impact: Something fresh brushes the part of you that imagines, believes and feels for others, so your ideals seem closer than before. You may find order and a tidy week coming up, with your natal Neptune located in your house of daily work.
interpretation.guidance: Trust the instinct that refuses to be tamed, and let it set one clear limit. A new kind of faith, in a person, a craft or a belief, may be forming, and it deserves a hearing.

interpretation.summary: The South Node is sextile your natal Moon. Your well-worn ways of finding comfort work easily, so rest comes quickly.
interpretation.timing: Exact on September 30, and felt from May 17 to December 7.
interpretation.impact: Your feelings find support, so asking for what you need comes more easily. A cause you back may come into view, with your natal Moon placed in your house of friendship.
interpretation.guidance: Lean on your best-practiced skills, and let ease do some of the work. What would feel nourishing to you, and who could share it?

interpretation.summary: Old routines and learned discipline support you, so a familiar structure can carry a present goal, as Saturn forms a trine to your natal South Node.
interpretation.timing: In effect from April 10, 2026 to May 19, 2027, exact on March 15, 2027.
interpretation.impact: What you already do well feels welcome, and nothing about it has to be proven.
interpretation.guidance: Use the steadiness on offer for a task that rewards patience, one dependable step after another. A habit that serves you is worth keeping on purpose, and saying so out loud helps.

interpretation.summary: Neptune is square your natal Jupiter: you want clarity but keep running into fog, so a straight answer would be welcome. The theme stays with you for years, mostly in your house of travel and belief.
interpretation.detailed:
Neptune sets the tone here. The vagueness is uncomfortable, yet it can clear away illusions that were not serving you and leave what is closer to the truth. A promise may sound better than it is, which sends you to the fine print before you believe it. Another long story runs beside it: the North Node meets your natal Venus from your relationship realm, with you until April 24, 2027. Small decisions start to feel like votes for the life you want, and casting each with care gives you a heading. Affection and timing line up, so your values lead you toward people who feel right.

On a shorter clock, Mars forms a sextile to your natal Moon from your house of self, with you until December 10, 2026. A wish to improve your space turns into a task you enjoy. Nearer the surface, Venus forms an opposition to your natal Mercury from your realm of learning, in effect until December 8, 2026. An honest remark of yours may land a little off, and a calm word afterward evens it out. Today has a lunar note too: the Moon trines your natal North Node, in your house of friendship. Belonging comes easily, which tells you where to grow.

Dreams worth keeping can stand a plain question or two.
